description: Use when a pharmacy, supply chain, or compliance agent needs FDA drug recall status for an NDC or drug name. Returns recall records (status, classification, reason, dates), match_confidence (ndc_exact or name_match), normalized ndc11, and openFDA provenance — never silently returning a different product's recalls. Example: NDC 41163-703-10 — Class II nasal spray recall records with termination dates. Source: openFDA drug/ndc and drug/enforcement. | x402 SLA: $0.10 USDC per call. Returns HTTP 503 (no charge) when upstream data sources unavailable. data_sources[] discloses provenance bound by synthesis.output_hash.
name: get_drug_recall_status
title: Get Drug Recall Status
